newsitem.title: USA: Nine West says plans to open 240 new stores.
newsitem.headline: Nine West says plans to open 240 new stores.

text.p: Nine West Group Inc said Thursday it plans to open about 140 U.S. stores during the remainder of 1997, and about 100 stores in international markets in 1997.
The company said it has secured commitments on about 125 of its planned 140 stores in the U.S.
The company reported earnings per share for the first quarter of $0.48 compared with earnings per share of $0.41 for the same period a year ago.
Nine West Group makes and sells women's shoes.
